choose.when:
<set-variable name="movieId" value="@{
                var movies = ((IResponse)context.Variables["getMoviesByTitleResponse"]).Body.As();

                if (movies.Count == 0)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                if (movies.Count > 1)
                {
                    throw new Exception("More than one movie was found with the supplied title.");
                }

                return (string)movies[0]["id"];
            }" />
